control_plane_enforcement.meaning: The hosted qualification workflow complied with shared A-01 control-plane policy. This is not an A-01 target qualification PASS for the 2H software subject.

proven: Pause creates an exact workflow/plan/source-bound checkpoint and never leaves an interrupted task marked RUNNING.
Verified completed tasks and their governed references remain preserved across pause/resume and cancellation.
Interrupted provider work preserves exact Phase-2F operation identity in the checkpoint.
Interrupted registered-idempotent provider work can become eligible for later same-operation scheduling without executing provider work or retry in this packet.
Interrupted non-idempotent PROSE.GENERATE_REVISION_CANDIDATE remains blocked for reconciliation and is not automatically regenerated.
A changed Book/manuscript source identity rejects resume and requires a new workflow identity.
Cancellation is terminal for the same workflow identity; a cancelled workflow cannot resume in place.
Unverified task completion is not trusted as completed after pause.
Author/required-authority waits remain blocked and cannot be synthesized or bypassed.
Declared-but-unavailable specialist or canon interfaces remain blocked and are not replaced with guessed providers.
ADMISSION_PENDING workflows are outside orchestrator pause/cancel authority.
Interrupted operation-idempotency tampering, pre-pause plan-binding tampering, checkpoint-digest tampering, raw manuscript content and canonical-effect tampering fail closed.
Resume decisions are deterministic for identical bound inputs.
All qualified pause/resume/cancellation outputs preserve the original manuscript and authorize no canonical manuscript effect.
non_claims: No provider retry or reconciliation was executed.
No fresh blind scoring or evaluator-isolation qualification occurred.
No durable persistence or crash-survival storage guarantee was proven; durable storage remains a later binding requirement.
No A-01 target qualification PASS is claimed for this 2H software subject.
